full_details: At nine Phillips took Nick through the roll on the lute, a full third below every queen he has pitched since he was eleven. Nick can hold it if he comes in under the note. You preferred her so and changed no word. Phillips counted two-and-thirty mornings to the sixth of December. Arthur had the lines in case and did not speak them. You were not in Richard III at two, and you did not cross for Wonder of a Woman. At home you wrote the vault and struck it out. You stayed seated.
one_sentence: You heard Juliet a third under the note, and at home you struck a vault.
title: Heard Juliet a third under the note
